SoCloudyBro is the messaging app for friends, families, and communities. Encrypted chats, voice and video calls, group spaces, and more — right in your browser, totally free.

Real conversations, real privacy.

Getting started

Ready in under a minute.

1
Sign up for free

Hit Sign Up, enter your name, email, and a password. Takes less than a minute.

2
Pick your SCB number

Choose any unused 4–5 digit number (1000–99999). This becomes your permanent handle — share it so friends can find you.

3
Add contacts

Search for friends by their SCB number or share your own. Chats are end-to-end encrypted automatically.

4
Start chatting

Message, call, react, and share — everything works right in your browser, no app needed.

Privacy Policy Contact

Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

What SoCloudyBro is

SoCloudyBro is a private, invite-based messaging platform. It lets registered users send end-to-end encrypted messages, make voice and video calls, and share updates within a trusted community.

What data we collect

  • Account data: Your name, a user number, and optionally an email address and profile photo.
  • Messages: Stored encrypted in Firebase. Content is only readable on your device with your encryption key.
  • Usage data: Basic connection metadata (timestamps, online status) to deliver messages.
  • Google sign-in: If you sign in with Google, we receive your Google account name and email. We do not store your Google password.

How we use your data

Your data is used solely to operate SoCloudyBro. We do not sell, share, or use your data for advertising. Messages are end-to-end encrypted and we cannot read them.

Data storage

Data is stored in Google Firebase (Europe West region). We do not operate our own servers. Firebase's data processing terms apply.

Your rights

You can delete your account at any time from Settings. This removes your profile and messages from our database.

Contact

Questions? Email support@socloudybro.vercel.app

📞 Contact Us

Reach out to an SCB admin directly. Tap an SCB Number to open a chat, or copy an email address.

🛡 Report a Security Vulnerability

Found a genuine security issue — a way to bypass auth, read someone else's messages, escalate admin access, or similar? Please report it privately here rather than as a public bug report or on social media, so it can be fixed before anyone else finds it.

  • Give us a reasonable chance to fix it before any public disclosure.
  • Don't access, modify, or delete data beyond what's needed to demonstrate the issue.
  • Never test against other users' real accounts — use test accounts only.
  • Include steps to reproduce, impact, and affected version/URL if known.
Security Contact
security@socloudybro.vercel.app

We don't currently run a paid bug bounty program, but we credit researchers (with permission) once a reported issue is fixed, and take every genuine report seriously.
